player_prompt.intro:
U n'wi Player {player_id} eka Quantum Tic Tac Toe.
Xihlwele xa wena i '{symbol}', naswona namba ya ku hambana ya wena i {parity} (e.g., X1, X3 or O2, O4).

Ntirho: U thole eka ku endla mstari wa tsevu ya tsevu ya klasiki (yehlelwa eka superpositions).

Ku thola:
- Eka ku hambana kaku, weka xihlwele xa spooky eka mirhangu mi mbirhi yehova eka format '[a,b]'.
- Xihlwele lexi xi entangled, naswona xi labeliwa njenga 'X1 / X1' or 'O4 / O4'.
- U nga yi weki xihlwele xa spooky eka mrhangu lowu wu kona ku collapsed (solidified).

Ntirho wa Collapse:
- Loko ku hambana kaku ku endla cycle eka entanglement graph, ku collapsed automatically.
- Xihlwele xa spooky eka cycle xi hundzuka xihlwele xa klasiki eka yin'we ya mipositioni yimbirhi.
- Xihlwele xa dependent spooky xi collapsed.

Vhitoria:
- Mchezo wu fela loko player u na tsevu tsevu ya klasiki eka mstari.
- Loko vatakatifu vambirhi va thola mstari eka ku collapsed kaku, loyi a na namba ya ku hambana ya tsevu u thole.

Mfano wa ku hambana: '[0,4]' weka xihlwele xa spooky eka seli 0 na 4.
